reason: The cell, Z, and germanate-mica average framework are strongly supported, but exact recovery is not sufficiently established. The comparable whole-pattern report supplies no Rwp, and the submitted P1 model is an ordered Al/Ge decoration of coordinates copied from a C2/m averaged database structure; no atomic coordinates, occupancies, or ordered symmetry alternatives were refined against the pattern. Although seven diffraction-distinct Al/Ge decorations were screened, the full-profile screen used a crude fixed profile and only the selected decoration received the final profile/cell fit, while the claimed ordering decision relied mainly on ten low-angle integrated intensities. A further attempt should compare the surviving orderings and plausible ordered subgroups with identical whole-pattern refinement and allow order-induced coordinate relaxation, retaining alternatives if the discrete ambiguity remains.
